audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[].side is nearly all Skill (1-6, 1st item) except Sona at 2+ items, while content win[] says Milio for Levels 1 through 4-5, Skill at Level 6, and Sona from 1st item on. The two layers disagree at 6 of 7 rows.
audit.why: content's whys[] are kit-grounded and match its own win[]: Milio's Q (Ultra Mega Fire Kick) has 1200 range versus Sona's Q at 825, giving him the early poke edge, while Sona's aura stacking and Power Chord out-poke his shield uptime once she has a first item, and his single-layer E shield can't cover a whole teamfight late.
audit.corrected: Align full phases[].side to content win[]: Milio, Milio, Milio, Milio, Skill, Sona, Sona.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers in it at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: The field exists to give players real cooldown numbers to play around.
audit.corrected: Cite Sona's R (100-140s) and Milio's E (2 charges, fast recharge) directly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Milio's R (Breath of Life) removes CC from allies in range — it directly answers a landed Crescendo — but nothing on the page states that Sona has no cleanse of her own for it, and dosFull[1].d/dontsFull[2].d were copy-pasted from tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Committing Crescendo into an up Breath of Life is the single most common way this lane goes wrong for Sona, and the page didn't say so anywhere concrete.
audit.corrected: State that Sona has no answer to a landed Breath of Life cleanse and must force it out before committing R.

edits.before: Q-poke the contacts — the rebound catches the second body; bot stands in pairs.
edits.after: Ultra Mega Fire Kick (Q) outranges her early Hymn poke at 1200 vs 825.

edits.before: E-shields begin: two charges of trade insurance; count them like summoners.
edits.after: Kick-plus-campfire spike beats her before Power Chord stacks.

edits.before: Full kit: the campfire's range gift means your duo out-ranges theirs standing still.
edits.after: Full kit online: your ramping heals still out-trade her Aria poke.

edits.before: Chip and warm the margins — the burn passive taxes every shielded trade.
edits.after: E haste lets you dodge her poke while your W keeps out-sustaining hers.

edits.before: First item: the fire compounds and the range zone decides every poke war.
edits.after: Crescendo out-ranges your R — the window drops to her if she flanks.

edits.before: Late Milio un-CCs teamfights: cleanse the chain, range the siege, and warm the carry through everything.
edits.after: Late-game: aura stacking and a timed Crescendo outscale Milio's single-layer peel once your carry is online.

edits.before: - Milio vs Sona - Track: Sona Crescendo. - Track his engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - The duo goes when Crescendo is down. - The R decides fights; it doesn't advertise them.
edits.after: - Sona vs Milio - Track: Milio Breath of Life. - Track her engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - The duo goes when Breath of Life is down. - The R decides fights; it doesn't advertise them.

edits.before: Q the rebound through the pair, warm the carry, auto — the burn ledger compounds while the buttons wait.
edits.after: Milio's E has 2 charges — bait one out before you commit, then punish the empty window.

edits.before: Spending the R on a single stun — the cleanse answers chains; chains wait for it to be gone.
edits.after: Sona has no cleanse of her own for Breath of Life — force it out early, don't R hoping to out-heal it.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Helia/Moonstone, Swiftness, Redemption paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo's sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Helia/Moonstone, Swiftness, Redemption paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo's sustain.

edits.before: Your CC plus jungler arrival decides bot — ping gank windows on his engage cooldown and hold the river bush vision.
edits.after: Your CC plus jungler arrival decides bot — ping gank windows on her engage cooldown and hold the river bush vision.

edits.before: - Sona Crescendo: matchup-defining — The stun chord flips grouped fights — spread while it is up. The duo's tempo bends around it. - Keep R Breath of Life banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Sona's R Crescendo resets on a 100-140s clock — spread while it's up, it flips grouped fights. - Milio's E has 2 charges on a fast cooldown — expect back-to-back shields. - Bank R for her landed Crescendo, not the poke.
